method.evidence_type: observed shell command results; no program build or GUI validation
method.search_boundary: Current PATH; selected toolchain variables; standard Qt roots; named Visual Studio roots; named vcpkg installed roots; selected Windows SDK paths; CMake/Qt/Windows SDK and filtered uninstall registry entries; Ubuntu WSL2 tool/package queries. This is not an exhaustive drive-wide absence proof.
method.runtime_effect: Ubuntu was stopped in the first WSL list. wsl -d Ubuntu --exec sh ... started it for inspection; subsequent list reported Running. No WSL install/update/shutdown or distro configuration was performed.
limitations: No C++20 compile/link smoke test was run.
No Qt Windows kit found inside bounded search; a custom unsearched prefix remains possible.
Qt Linux package/version and pkg-config availability do not prove that this project builds or its GUI launches.
WSLg environment and directory presence do not establish a working rendered GUI.
REA MCP/JDK/Ghidra are outside this subtask and are verified by the coordinating investigator.
Only selected toolchain environment variables were inspected; no ambient environment dump was saved.
Only official XML/directory/HEAD/checksum metadata and framework/toolchain docs were fetched for the proposal. No Qt binary archive, Qt installer or original Explorer++ source was downloaded.

msvc.version_probe_note: cl /Bv printed the compiler/pass versions and D8003 because no source was supplied. It was a version probe, not a successful build.

qt6.registry_note: HKCU Software/QtProject exists and has QMake and OrganizationDefaults children, but inspected keys exposed no installation prefix. This is not SDK evidence.

runtime_registration.verification: Registry metadata only; actual application dependency resolution and runtime smoke test not performed.

qt6.cmake_prefix_evidence: Observed Qt6Config.cmake, Qt6WidgetsConfig.cmake, Qt6TestConfig.cmake and Qt6ConcurrentConfig.cmake present in this prefix via read-only test -f.
qt6.qml_development_package_status: not returned by selected dpkg-query; not independently tested

intended_components: moc/uic/rcc and related base build tools
qttools deployment tools including windeployqt, subject to archive inventory verification
minimal_install_proposal.archive_content_status: Expected module ownership from Qt distribution layout; no archive payload fetched/listed. Must verify exact files and dependencies before promotion and must not claim successful SDK setup before configure/build/test/runtime.
minimal_install_proposal.installer_dependency_distinction: The full Qt online-installer package declares Qt Creator/docs/examples dependencies. Proposed selective archive extraction is deliberately not the full installer dependency closure and must be described as a minimal SDK subset.

extractor.support: Upstream documents 7z reading; actual extraction of selected archives remains untested.

minimal_install_proposal.compiler_compatibility: Qt 6.8's tested Windows compiler is MSVC2022. Microsoft documents MSVC2022/2026 ABI compatibility with newer linker/runtime conditions. Building Qt6.8.3 prebuilt libraries with installed MSVC19.51 is an inference to validate, not a Qt-tested-toolchain claim.
planned_actions_after_approval: Download exactly the two official archive URLs to the workspace-local downloads directory; verify bytes and official SHA1 sidecars, and record computed SHA256.

List each archive with existing Windows tar; reject absolute paths or escaping members and confirm only expected SDK content. Verify expected Qt6 component CMake files, DLL/import-library/header/tool identities.

Extract to a new staging directory below tools\qt. Refuse overwrite of any pre-existing SDK prefix; preserve that directory and prepare a reviewed backup/replacement plan if state changes before execution.

Inspect relocatability using explicit qmake/qtpaths queries; apply only narrowly needed prefix configuration inside the new SDK if required, recording changes. Promote the validated new SDK under the requested prefix.
Set Qt/CMake/Ninja/MSVC locations only in dedicated child build environments. Do not modify user or machine PATH or registry.

Run the same C++20/Qt6 Widgets/Test/Concurrent configure/build/test/runtime smoke checks for both A and B workspaces with the same SDK and compiler. Record hashes/versions, all failures, and GUI/deployment limitations.

resource_bounds.note: Upper bound is derived from aggregate metadata and excludes staging copies, filesystem overhead and future build outputs. It is not a measured subset size.

minimal_install_proposal.baseline_parity: A and B must receive identical OS/toolchain/Qt versions and flags, fixtures and runtime inputs. Their difference is REA information access; this toolchain proposal must not introduce an A/B environment difference.

probe_failures.outcome: PowerShell rejected the pipeline after foreach at parse time; no inventory commands executed in that failed invocation.
probe_failures.corrected_by: Initial inventory was rerun with an explicit inventory array before ConvertTo-Json.

probe_failures.outcome: The first shell script used double quotes around dpkg-query's ${...} format, so sh reported Bad substitution after identifying tool paths. Replaced by single-quoted dpkg format in linux-tool-versions.

PowerShell splatted a scalar string as individual characters in the dynamic argument list, so version probes failed. MSVC accidentally reached its linker with B/v operands and failed LNK1181 before producing an executable. Subsequent explicit Test-Path checks found no B.exe/B.obj/B.ilk/B.pdb. Replaced by direct Python subprocess argument arrays.
The first SDK path list concatenated into one malformed combined string. No SDK absence conclusion was taken from that result; repeated with literal paths in sdk-tools-corrected.
